name: National Career Service
description: India's premier digital employment exchange platform connecting active job seekers, verified employers, training providers, and career centers.
dataProvided: Real-time industry vacancies, job postings by state & district, active applicant demographics, placement records, and employer demand volumes.
dataVolume: 3.8+ Crore Job Seekers | 35+ Lakh Active Employers

name: Periodic Labour Force Survey
description: Authoritative nationwide sample survey estimating labour force participation, unemployment rates, and formal vs informal employment characteristics.
dataProvided: Labour Force Participation Rate (LFPR), Worker Population Ratio (WPR), Unemployment Rate (UR), and employment distribution across NIC industrial codes.
dataVolume: 1.01+ Lakh Sample Households surveyed per annum

name: e-Shram National Database
description: Comprehensive centralized registry of India's unorganized sector workers, gig workers, platform workers, and migrant agricultural labourers.
dataProvided: Primary and secondary occupation classifications, self-declared vocational skills, migration flow corridors, age demographics, and social security coverage.

name: Skill India Digital Hub
description: Next-generation digital public infrastructure unifying skilling programs, PMKVY certifications, ITI passouts, and apprenticeship schemes.
dataProvided: Institutional certified workforce supply, active skilling enrollment numbers, PMKVY and apprenticeship completion rates, and candidate skill transcripts.

name: National Classification of Occupations 2015
description: Standardized Indian occupational classification framework aligned with the International Standard Classification of Occupations (ISCO-08).
dataProvided: Standard 4-digit and 8-digit NCO codes, standardized occupation titles, task descriptions, qualification minimums, and inter-trade mappings.

name: National Council for Vocational Education and Training
description: Apex vocational education regulator establishing standards, National Occupational Standards (NOS), and NSQF qualification compliance.
dataProvided: National Skill Qualification Framework (NSQF Levels 1-10), approved Qualification Packs (QPs), National Occupational Standards, and accreditor records.

name: Ministry of Skill Development & Entrepreneurship
description: Nodal Union Ministry coordinating all skill development efforts across government, NSDC, DGT, Sector Skill Councils, and international mobility pacts.
dataProvided: National skilling policies, Sector Skill Council (SSC) allocations, ITI modernisation funds, Apprenticeship Act implementations, and state grants.

name: Open Government Data Platform
description: India's central open data portal publishing machine-readable datasets across census, industry, education, trade, and economic indicators.
dataProvided: District-level census workforce indicators, economic census data, state industrial employment aggregates, and open government API endpoints.
